user_requirements: Microphone with supplied calibration covering 32 kHz
Own equipment rather than borrowing a microphone
Direct speaker and playback-interface buying links
finding: No inexpensive USB microphone meeting all requirements was verified. The clearest readily purchasable reference candidate is Earthworks M50 with a documented compatible Mac audio interface. This is a recommendation, not a purchase or assembled qualification.

recommended_parts.availability: B&H and Sweetwater list in stock; unreserved.
recommended_parts.evidence: Manufacturer specifies 3 Hz-50 kHz, individual printed response chart and downloadable per-unit ECF after registration, and 24-48 V phantom at 10 mA. Included ADP1 is a half-inch calibrator adapter.
recommended_parts.limits: No particular delivered unit's ECF was accessed. Retain the actual serial-specific chart/file and check relevant frequency coverage upon receipt. Microphone calibration is distinct from complete analog-gain-chain SPL calibration.

recommended_parts.item: Audient iD4 MKII playback and microphone interface
recommended_parts.availability: Both retailers list in stock; B&H price is lower in this check.
recommended_parts.evidence: 48 V +/-4 V at 10 mA/channel; microphone preamp at minimum gain and ADC specified 10 Hz-40 kHz +/-0.5 dB; DAC 10 Hz-40 kHz +/-0.1 dB; maximum 96 kSa/s. Official instructions support Mac. USB-C cable included; sufficient USB power is required.
recommended_parts.role: Replaces the UMC204HD in the recommended M50 chain; performs playback, microphone power, gain and digitization. Do not add both interfaces to the recommended total.
recommended_parts.limits: One microphone/line input; second input is instrument-only and specified to 20 kHz. Gain-dependent assembled response must be measured. Internal direct-monitoring latency is not speaker acoustic timing.

recommended_parts.availability: Official US store displays in stock, ready to ship; unreserved.
recommended_parts.evidence: Manufacturer nominal range 52 Hz-40 kHz and balanced TRS input. Use one documented cabinet/channel for initial mono bench measurements.
recommended_parts.limits: Advertised band does not establish calibrated 32 kHz output or 10 ms-pip acoustic fidelity. Existing MR3 timing/firmware/standby bench checks still apply.

recommended_parts.role: Own a 1 kHz level reference to establish/check microphone plus interface sensitivity at the chosen fixed gain. M50 ADP1 and calibrator half-inch port nominally match; check seal.
recommended_parts.limits: Standard price excludes separately priced traceable certificate. One-frequency reference does not independently calibrate 32 kHz response or certify whole-chain absolute uncertainty.

accessories.role: Interface output to selected MR3 input

budget.basis: Observed main-item asking prices plus older accessory observations. 50 and 150 USD amounts are author-set allowances, not quotes or a delivered-price upper bound.
exclusions: Traceable certificate or external calibration services

cheaper_playback_only_option.availability: Fresh direct Sweetwater page displays in stock.
cheaper_playback_only_option.assessment: Remains the inexpensive playback-only choice previously discussed. Its retrieved specifications do not establish M50's required 10 mA phantom supply; this review therefore selects iD4 for the complete M50 path rather than assuming direct compatibility.

screening.reason: Mac and 192 kSa/s support, but supplied calibration stops at 20 kHz; accurate ultrasound requires custom calibration.
Sales page displays a 2026 sold-out notice, and no documented supplied 32 kHz calibration offering was established.
Useful Mac raw-ultrasound recording candidate, but supplied per-unit 32 kHz response/SPL calibration not established.
Calibrated high-frequency measurement package, but bundled software recommends Windows and warns of unreliable Macintosh/Linux use.
Nominal ultrasonic bandwidth and 1 kHz matching do not establish supplied individual 32 kHz calibration.

Credible cheaper candidate: current specs are +/-1 dB through 30 kHz and -3 dB cutoff at least 40 kHz, with individual calibration chart. However, the supplied chart/ECF high-frequency endpoint is not public, so supplied calibration through 32 kHz remains unverified. Do not conflate this G2 model with legacy M30.
Nominal 50 kHz and calibration options, but no retrieved public price, stock or supplied 32 kHz calibration detail; quote candidate rather than easy budget purchase.

ten_ms.method: Precompute a continuous sequence and capture the microphone waveform with fixed settings. Inspect the actual reference-position envelope, duration, spacing, ringing and event completeness, including highest retained frequencies.
ten_ms.status: Digital arithmetic only; no physical acoustic validation. 40 kHz ADC bandwidth cannot capture 64 kHz second harmonic of a 32 kHz tone, so do not claim complete high-frequency THD.

actions: Research and documented recommendations only. No vendor outreach, ordering, hardware operation, calibrated Rice sound measurement or 10 ms delivery claim.
